document.abstract: The aim and mission of the Society is to advance the technical aspects of the motion-picture; television, and the electronic imaging arts and sciences. As the organization that has the longest record of dealing with the professional requirements of moving images, the SMPTE has both contributed significantly to the development of the technology and program interchange and reported the benefits to be derived from the interplay of motion imaging and sound.
